definitions.full: H5475. sod סוֺד noun [masculine] council, counsel ; — ׳ס absolute Prov 11:13 +; construct Jer 6:11 +; suffix סוֺדִי 23:22 ; Job 19:19 ; סוֺדוֺ Amos 3:7 ; Prov 3:32 ; סֹדָם Gen 49:6 ; — 1 council , in familiar conversation; — a. divan or circle of familiar friends, ׳ס בַּחוּרִים Jer 6:11 , ׳מ משׂחקים 15:17 ; סוֺדִ ׳מְתֵי Job 19:19 men of my intimate circle ; (י בסוד ׅ׳עמד Jer 23:18 , 22 in the intimate circle of ׳י ; אלוה בסוד Job 15:8 ; in bad sense, ׳ס מְרֵעִים Psa 64:3 . b. assembly, company , ׳ס יְשָׁרִים Psa 111:1 (|| עֵדָה ; עמי סוֺד Ezek 13:9 ; ׳ס קדשׁים Psa 89:8 (of angels); in bad sense, בא בסוד Gen 49:6 (|| קהל ). 2 counsel , taken by those in familiar conversation: a. counsel itself, סוד באין מחשׁבות Prov 15:22 thoughts without counsel ; of intimate friendship, Psa 55:15 סוֺד נַמְתִּיק ; in bad sense, of crafty plotting 83:4 סוֺד יַעֲרִימוּ b. secret counsel , which may be revealed ( גלה ), Amos 3:7 ; Prov 11:13 ; 20:19 ; 25:9 . c. familiar converse with God, intimacy , ס ׳ליראיו ׳י Psa 25:14 intimacy with ׳י have those who fear him (|| ברית ), סודוֺ אתיֿשׁרים Prov 3:22 with the upright is his intimacy ; here also Job 29:4 (si vera lectio) Di De and others; Siegf Du compare Buhl Lex בְּסֹךְ when Eloah sheltered my tent.
